address: Rua Joaquim Antunes 260, São Paulo, 05415-000, Brazil
bio: A more relaxed offering from renowned chef Luiz Filipe. Located just a few metres from its older sibling, this “trattorita” boasts a contemporary brasserie style with a stunning bar by the entrance and an open kitchen upstairs with a wood-fired oven that is at the heart of some of its signature dishes. Felipe’s traditional Italian-style cooking adopts a modern touch here and features a wide choice of pastas, pizzas, meat and seafood... in portions that can easily be shared. One starter that is an absolute must is the ravioli filled with crab, ricotta and a yolk that simply falls apart when sliced, all of which is then topped with a butter, sage and a freshly grated pecorino cheese sauce. The desserts are equally fabulous, so make sure you save space at the end of your meal to enjoy them to...
